metadata.title: Naturalistic Male Portrait with Minimalist Sans-Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a man with sun-kissed skin and textured hair, set against a soft, neutral-grey studio background. The composition is tight, focusing on the eyes and facial texture, with minimalist white typography positioned in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool neutral background
Textured, layered hair framing the upper half of the face
Small-scale typography balanced against a large-scale subject
Direct, level gaze creating an intimate connection with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies approximately 80% of the frame, centered horizontally but slightly weighted towards the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the catchlights, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the mouth, then travels up the hair to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space restricted to the corners and the top edge of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the face with low saturation in the periphery; medium-high value contrast between the hair and skin.

letterConstructionRules: Italicized for the secondary portion of the text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using Roman and Italic weights for distinction.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary clarity and geometric balance for small-scale corner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail, close-up portrait of a man with medium-length feathered brown hair and sun-weathered skin. Use soft studio lighting against a neutral grey background. The framing should be tight on the face, showing the collar of a white t-shirt at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of all-caps white text in a geometric sans-serif font to the top right corner. Use a forward slash to separate two words, with the second word in italics.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture realistic and detailed?
Is the text small and tucked into the upper right corner?
Is the background a soft, non-distracting neutral tone?
Does the lighting feel natural and directional?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Record label logos in the corners

mustAchieve: Visible skin pores and fine lines

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes are level and looking at the camera.
Check that the white text is clearly legible against the background.
Verify the crop is tight, cutting off the top of the hair slightly.
Confirm the lighting creates a subtle shadow on one side of the face for depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + neutral studio background + upper-right minimalist sans-serif typography.
